time_accounting.denominator: sum of measured completed collection, learner, save intervals; excludes reset/evaluation/loading and uncommitted interrupted work
time_accounting.collection_includes: episode_started to episode_finished: policy inference, env stepping, episode replay write; excludes reset
time_accounting.save_includes: preceding finished event to checkpoint_committed: validation, hashing, serialization, fsync and receipt; excludes inherited initial-evaluation checkpoint without an interval
time_accounting.limit: collection-only Amdahl estimate, not a measured multi-environment speedup; learning resources/schedule held fixed
